data.body_html:
Marbella Pride 2042 is set to be the most vibrant celebration of diversity on the Costa del Sol. And there’s no better way to experience it than with a Marbella Pride 2042 yacht party Puerto Banús. Imagine cruising the Mediterranean with your closest friends, sipping cava, dancing to your favourite playlist, and watching the sunset over La Concha. All while the iconic Puerto Banús buzzes with Pride energy ashore. Our fleet of 16 boats departs directly from Puerto Banús, so you’re steps from the action. Whether you want an intimate sunset sail or a full-day floating fiesta, we have the perfect vessel for your Pride celebration.

Why Celebrate Marbella Pride 2042 on a Yacht?

Marbella Pride is about freedom, joy, and community. A yacht charter amplifies that spirit. You get total privacy for your group, unlimited drinks (included), and a skipper who handles everything. No queues, no crowded bars, no noise limits. You can anchor at Cala del Faro for a swim, or cruise past the Golden Mile with a glass of bubbly. The Costa del Sol in late June offers 28°C average temperatures and calm seas – perfect for a party on the water.

Our Fleet for Pride Parties

We have boats for every group size and budget. All depart from Puerto Banús, the heart of Marbella’s nightlife. Here’s a quick overview:

What’s Included in Your Pride Charter

Every booking comes with a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). That’s it – no hidden extras. You just bring your group and your playlist. The skipper will take you to the best spots, from the iconic Puerto Banús harbour to the secluded Cala Cortés.

How to Book Your Marbella Pride 2042 Yacht

Pride week is the busiest of the year in Puerto Banús. We recommend booking at least 4 weeks in advance. Simply contact us via WhatsApp or use the booking form on our website. A deposit secures your slot, and the balance is due 7 days before departure. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), prices start at €749 for 2 hours. The Mangusta 80 (Tier B) starts at €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. Other boats are priced on request – just ask.

Pride Itinerary Ideas

Here are three popular ways to spend your Pride charter:

  • Sunset Party (2–3 hours): Depart Puerto Banús at 18:00, cruise past the Golden Mile, anchor off Marbella Marina for sunset. Drinks and snacks included. From €749.
  • Beach & Swim (4–5 hours): Head to Cala del Faro or Cabopino for swimming. Lunch at a chiringuito. Return for the Pride parade. From €1,499.
  • Full-Day Fiesta (8 hours): Cruise to Estepona or Sotogrande. Jet ski from the Mangusta 80. BBQ on board. From €2,299.

All itineraries are flexible – talk to our team to customise yours.

Frequently asked questions

When is Marbella Pride 2042?

Marbella Pride 2042 is expected in late June, typically the last weekend. Exact dates are confirmed by the Marbella town hall a few months prior. The main parade and events happen in Puerto Banús and Marbella's old town.

Can I charter a yacht for a Pride party in Puerto Banús?

Absolutely. We have a fleet of 16 boats departing from Puerto Banús. For a party, the Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39) are popular for groups up to 11 guests. The Mangusta 80 offers more space and a free jet ski.

What is included in the yacht charter price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs.

How much does a yacht charter cost for Marbella Pride?

Tier A boats start at €749 for 2 hours and go up to €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) cost from €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours and include a free jet ski. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

How many people can join a yacht party?

Our boats accommodate from 5 guests (Dubhe or Mariah SX21) up to 12 guests (Mangusta 80, Azimut 58, Canados 86, Ferretti 94, and others). Check individual boat specs on our fleet page.

What happens if the weather is bad on the day?

Safety is our priority. If the skipper deems conditions unsafe, we offer a full refund or reschedule. In practice, Marbella enjoys over 300 sunny days a year, so cancellations are rare.

Can I bring my own decorations or music?

Yes, you can bring decorations and a Bluetooth speaker. Our boats already have sound systems, but you can connect your playlist. Please avoid glitter or confetti that could damage the boat.

How do I book a yacht for Marbella Pride 2042?

Contact us via WhatsApp or the booking form on our website. We recommend booking at least 4 weeks in advance for Pride week. A deposit secures your slot, and the balance is due 7 days before departure.
